title: The bill shows the cost — not what causes it
subtitle: One visible number, shaped by many hidden factors
a11yLabel: The electricity bill is only the visible symptom: what the bill shows, the hidden factors behind it, and what owners cannot see.

columns.heading: What the bill shows
bullets: The final amount, units consumed and the due date
Penalties and charges, buried in line items
A number that arrives after the money is spent

columns.heading: What stays hidden
bullets: Demand, power factor and time-of-use behaviour
Tariff category, contract demand and billing accuracy
Machine loading, schedules and solar performance

columns.heading: What owners cannot see
bullets: Which part of the bill was avoidable
Whether the cause is operational, technical or contractual

outcomes: Customers know what they paid — not what they could have prevented
